pattern.description: A burst of white light streaks floods the frame and hides the cut from a VR capture to live-action footage; the next caption word group appears centred over the new shot as the streaks clear.
pattern.why_premium: The cut is hidden inside a branded light effect, so mixed-reality and real footage join without a hard seam, and the caption change lands on the same beat, keeping the multi-shot caption sentence rhythmic.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.streaks', {opacity: 1, scale: 1.3, duration: 0.1, ease: 'power2.in'}).set('.clipA', {autoAlpha: 0}).set('.clipB', {autoAlpha: 1}).set('.caption', {textContent: 'to expand'}).to('.streaks', {opacity: 0, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out'}).fromTo('.caption', {opacity: 0}, {opacity: 1, duration: 0.1, ease: 'power1.out'}, '<')
build_hint.remotion: Streak overlay opacity via interpolate(frame, [0,2,5], [0,1,0], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); switch <Sequence> clips at the peak frame; caption opacity interpolate over 2-3 frames with Easing.out(Easing.quad). No spring needed.

notes: Same device as e007 (light-streak transition plus caption swap). The caption is already crisp in the first frame it appears, so it may be a hard cut-in hidden by the streaks rather than a fade.
